usage: jbus project [-h] {add,bases,close,open} ...

positional arguments:
  {add,bases,close,open}
    add                 add a project's table to the config
    bases               print each branch besides the default one that jmerge
                        merges the project into, or name one more with --add
    close               put the project away: no pass, word or task reaches it
                        until open
    open                bring a closed project back as it was

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
